purpose: Interpret one schema-valid Sleep Session projection, schema version 1, into the type-specific body of a Canonical Revision through the interpret-source-projection@1 processor interface: every stage in source order with its exact instants and SDK stage code, and the session's title and notes verbatim, checked for a non-empty session and for stages that are non-empty and inside the session, without classifying, unioning, clipping, gap-filling, or timing stages and without splitting the session.

inputs.name: sleep_session_record
inputs.description: The decoded record object of one Sleep Session projection, schema version 1, as interpret-source-projection@1 passes it after closed-schema validation, the year-range and reversed-interval checks, and time attribution: start and end instants with their optional offsets, optional title and notes, and the stages, each with start and end instants without offsets and a declared stage code.

inputs.name: temporal_header
inputs.description: The interval temporal header interpret-source-projection@1 built for the projection; its exact endpoint instants bound the stages, and its end endpoint carries the wake date that Phase 5 uses.

inputs.name: sdk_rules
inputs.description: The start-before-end rules that the pinned Health Connect SDK 1.1.0 SleepSessionRecord and stage constructors enforce, recorded in this unit's pack.

outputs.name: sleep_session_body
outputs.description: The Sleep Session body, version 1: every stage in source order with its exact start and end instant text and its stage code, plus the title and notes verbatim when present; no stage classes, durations, unions, gap fill, local dates, or copy of the header.

outputs.name: quarantine_outcome
outputs.description: A Quarantine with one of this processor's declared health-data-free reasons, sleep-session-empty, sleep-stage-outside-session, sleep-stage-reversed, or sleep-stage-empty, and the JSON pointer of the offending source field, never a value.

owns: the Sleep Session body, version 1, and its declared code field
the Sleep Session validity rules beyond the closed schema: a non-empty session, and stages that are non-empty and inside the session
the Sleep Session quarantine reasons and the source field each one names
does_not_own: envelope decoding, schema validation, the revision header, time attribution, Policy-Pending, or canonical bytes, which interpret-source-projection@1 owns
persisting outcomes, Processing Jobs, or Processor Generations
wake-date attribution, stage classes, overlap union or unresolved overlap, unclassified gaps, durations, source selection, or summaries, which Phase 5 owns
display names for stages or presentation
